content.short: Benqi is a leading decentralized liquidity market and liquid staking protocol natively built on Avalanche.
content.description: Benqi is a cornerstone DeFi protocol on the Avalanche network, providing a comprehensive suite of financial products including a decentralized lending market and liquid staking solutions. Users can easily supply and borrow digital assets to earn interest or gain leverage, while the protocol's liquid staking arm allows participants to unlock the value of their staked AVAX. By providing sAVAX, users can earn validator rewards while remaining liquid to participate in other Avalanche-based dApps. Benqi focuses on high performance, deep liquidity, and a robust security framework, making it an essential hub for capital efficiency and decentralized asset management within the rapidly growing Avalanche ecosystem.
content.meta: Benqi is the leading liquidity market and liquid staking protocol on Avalanche, providing secure and efficient DeFi solutions for global users.
